column1: Source: National Grid ESO Future Energy Scenarios (FES) 2024 Data Workbook, Energy Consumers section, Additional Graphs subsection, EC.I: Total Annual Fuel Demand for Residential Heat. The dataset presents historical and projected annual residential heating fuel demand across Great Britain. Historical values are taken from the ECUK 2022 End Use Tables (non-weather-corrected), with dh_heat subtracted as it represents the thermal demand supplied through district heating networks.
